threepl.codegen

Interface SpecialLabels

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    TDE

    public interface SpecialLabels
    This interface contains strings for labeling parameters, input signals and output signals for TDESPECIAL TDEs codes 6 (GT_CUSTOM) and 8 (GTP_DUAL). Code 7 is GT_AURORA but this has never been used and will probably never be used and hence has also never been checked for correctness!
